fields.description: Groups the cells of one kernel invocation. Not a link to any other doctype - a kernel is a live container, not a record; this is only what lets an audit reader tell which rows came from the same `NotebookKernel`.
fields.label: Session

fields.description: The ordered cell sources run against this kernel, as a JSON array - the artifact that makes a session re-runnable and reviewable, the same reasoning `Nakhoda Agent Run.operations` records the operations that answered a question.
fields.label: Code

fields.description: One `{stdout, result, error}` object per cell, in the same order as `code` - what the kernel actually returned, not just what was asked of it.
fields.label: Results

fields.description: Set on `status != ok`. `unavailable` means Docker itself was missing or unreachable - no cell ran at all, per Phase 7's "ship nothing" fallback (`12-build-plan.md`).
fields.label: Error
